claim: `MonoidHom.isDedekindFiniteMonoid_of_injective` is named under the hom namespace even though the declaration constructs an `IsDedekindFiniteMonoid`; this misses the predicate-namespace API shape for `IsDedekindFiniteMonoid` lemmas.
requested_change: Rename the theorem to `_root_.IsDedekindFiniteMonoid.of_injective` (or move it outside `namespace MonoidHom` as `IsDedekindFiniteMonoid.of_injective`) and update its uses, e.g. in `MulEquivClass.isDedekindFiniteMonoid_iff`.

claim: `invertibleOfLeftInverse` (and the adjacent `invertibleOfRightInverse`) unnecessarily inherits the surrounding `[Monoid α]` assumption, although the construction only needs `MulOne` plus `IsDedekindFiniteMonoid`.
requested_change: Move these two definitions out of the `[Monoid α]` section and state them with `variable [MulOne α] [IsDedekindFiniteMonoid α] (a b : α)`.

claim: The `SubmonoidClass` instance transferring `IsDedekindFiniteMonoid` to a submonoid is not marked `@[to_additive]`, so the additive counterpart for `AddSubmonoidClass` is missing.
requested_change: Add `@[to_additive]` to this instance so additive submonoids inherit `IsDedekindFiniteAddMonoid` as well.
